title: Accelerator Pedal Response and Operation
summary: This topic centers on accelerator pedal operation, with complaints about malfunction, replacement, abrupt response, and lift-off behavior alongside several fragments that only describe pedal use without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive feedback praises how the vehicle feels when lifting off the accelerator pedal.

negative.summary: Negative feedback reports accelerator pedal malfunction, pedal replacement, disliked lift-off deceleration behavior, and references to similar pedal issues.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention sticky pedal feel, quick takeoff with slight pedal input, regeneration preferences, and incomplete descriptions of pressing or releasing the accelerator without enough context for clear sentiment.

limitations: Most fragments are short service-style notes with limited context, so many examples cannot be interpreted beyond the immediate wording.
Some examples mix distinct subjects such as hardware malfunction, pedal feel, regenerative braking behavior, and general acceleration response rather than one single coherent issue.
